title: Albert Collins, Artist and Actor
content: Albert Collins (1883-1956) was an Australian painter who worked in watercolor.He taught at Redlands School in Cremorne, where his design course was popular.He was also a radio actor, known for playing the character of "Joe" of the Children's Session in the long-running serial "The Wide-awake Bunyip," which later was called the "Muddle-Headed Wombat."---Albert Collins on Wikipedia
